The vendor directly providing **OpenCart** at **opencart.com** is **OpenCart Limited** (founded and led by developer **Daniel Kerr**).

### Evidence & Provider Statements:
* **Operating Company:** On the official contact page for `opencart.com`, the office is listed under the legal company name:  
  > *"OpenCart Limited, Unit G 2/F Tower 2 Avignon, 1 Kwun Chui Road, So Kwan Wat, Tuen Mun, Hong Kong."*
* **Company History:** The official Company page notes under June 2012: *"Registered OpenCart as an business in Hong Kong,"* with Daniel Kerr listed as creator/lead of the team.

record.description: OpenCart is a powerful online store management software that enables users to manage multiple online stores from a single interface. Catering to a diverse range of users, from web developers to first-time online entrepreneurs, OpenCart offers extensive customization options and tools to optimize the performance of online shops. With over 900,000 active websites in 138 countries contributing to more than $1 billion in economic activity, OpenCart continues to grow, providing thousands of plugins to enhance online business capabilities.
